name: summrise-desktop-electron
description: Summrise Desktop — Electron shell over the local summrise-agent service (SecureCRT-style multi-session workspace: terminal / SSH / serial / browser) with AI control. Stage-m: TS main process, agent lifecycle in Rust.
//scripts: THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO `build` SCRIPT HERE — the shell's shipped artifact is src/*.js, emitted by a SIBLING package. agent/summrise-agent-npm `npm run build` compiles this directory's tsconfig (`tsc -p ../summrise-desktop-electron/tsconfig.json --outDir /tmp/... --noCheck`) and copies main/preload.js into src/ (the POLICIES are wasm now, in two crates that do not depend on each other: agent/summrise-url-policy's build.sh installs summrise_url_policy.js and summrise_url_policy_bg.wasm beside them, agent/summrise-shell-policy's installs summrise_shell_policy.js and summrise_shell_policy_bg.wasm, and this directory's suite loads both committed pairs); ci.yml, release.yml and publish-release.sh each re-emit and cmp it (`electron src freshness`), so a stale src/*.js is RED in CI instead of silently shipped. The removed script was `tsc -p tsconfig.json`, which wrote the gitignored dist/ that nothing read — and `start`/`dist` invoked it, which is why both are rewritten here rather than left calling a script that no longer exists.
